name: receiptdrop
description: Upload, search, view, and update ReceiptDrop receipts, query Footprints, cross-check trips, and generate reimbursement packages from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Upload, find, view, and manage receipts.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your ReceiptDrop account to query synced Footprint activities, upload and search receipts, cross-check business trips, view attachments, update details, confirm expenses, and generate reimbursement packages.
